## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0bfc1c3a3020104ac9d9e520a7bcb073b38dfc25`
Local-runs: none
Scope: AGENTS.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Inputs read: card #37887 (body and all six comments, ruling 7233980615 included), PR #38127 (body, file list, net diff of the head against merge base `8e3980a92937a4e9c2042409daa9bca6020670c3`), the check-runs on the head, and, read but not reviewed, the ratchet header at the head, ruling records 6184799323, 7044162186, 7046610679 and 6120820653, and the rest of `AGENTS.md` at the head. The area also cites a maintainer decision-card choice (option A, 2026-11-28 04:25Z) made in the project's own chat; that card is not on GitHub, it is cited by the area and NOT read by me, and nothing below rests on it.

### ① Derived judgments

- Ratchet accept-set, `AGENTS.md` row of `CEILINGS`: 78401 → 78675, the gate now accepts 274 more bytes. Right. Blob sizes read off the two trees: 78401 at the merge base, 78675 at the head, so the row moves by exactly the measured delta and headroom stays 0. No other row, pin or line of the script moves.
- Rule accept-set: a new binding ⛔ sentence under Documentation Guardrails. It changes what a dev and a reviewer accept (a volatile count is refused in user-facing output, docs, skills text and test baselines; a count-sync check is deleted with it). Right against the card's draft and ruling 7233980615, subject to S1 and S2 in ④.
- Translations row: the path cell loses its package tally, "all nine" becomes "them all" twice. Right: the glob `**/translations/*.generated.ts` already carries the scope, no command, gate name or prohibition changes, and the row shrinks, so the table-row pin is untouched.
- Spec artifacts sentence: "six checked-in generated artifacts, each with its own CI gate" becomes "Each checked-in generated artifact ... has its own CI gate". Right: same claim without the tally; the table below it is unchanged.
- Public surface: none. No package source, schema, export, generated artifact or runtime string is in the diff. No gate in `scripts`, `.claude`, `.github` pins the deleted wording (the one other "nine packages" mention is a dated audit under `docs/audits`, outside the diff).
- Check-runs on the head: every run concluded success or skipped, none failed or pending; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are success. These are the gate verdicts; nothing was re-run.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, label `skip-changeset`, `Check Changeset` skipped. Right: `AGENTS.md` and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` ship in no package's `files[]`, so the diff publishes nothing.
`Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim. Right: no published accept-set narrows or widens; the only accept-set that moves is the internal byte ratchet, by ruling.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev open question, how the +414 B overage is paid (options A raise, B pay by deletion, C shorten): answered by ruling 7233980615 and executed as A plus B plus C together. The rule was shortened, the two counts the dev found were deleted, and the row was raised by the 274 B that remained.
- PR body and claim amendment 7232932589 flag: does the citation suffice for the raise. Answered: it suffices. Letter B of 6184799323 asks for a ruling of record that orders text into the ratcheted file, its comment id and the measured byte delta quoted in the raising PR's body, and a row moved in the same PR by at most that delta; it needs no second word from the maintainer. The body quotes 7233980615 and +274 B, the row moves 274, and the row comment names both records in the form the 7044162186 raise used. The order of the text into `AGENTS.md` is the maintainer's 「同意」 to the placement (card filing gate) restated by 「没用的统计数字直接删，不同步」; 7233980615 is the comment id that carries both, transcribed by the seat as 7044162186 and 7046610679 were. One caution, recorded and not graded: the verbatim words answer "how is the overage paid" and, read alone, also fit pay-by-deletion only; the raise stands on letter B (text ordered in is the authorization), not on those words choosing a raise. The unread decision card is said to settle the same point; see N2.
- Dev deviation, first edit before the full read of `AGENTS.md`: no effect on the diff, except that the full read did not surface the collision in S1.
- Dev deviation, ratchet edit attempted outside the file surface and refused: closed by the claim amendment, which widens the surface to that one row; the head changes that one row only.
- Dev out-of-scope finding (the "six" and "nine" tallies): taken into this PR by the ruling; see S2 for the one left.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): not applicable, the diff holds no query, id materialisation or join.

### ④ Design judgment

`AGENTS.md`, the rule against the card's draft, ruling 7233980615 and the rest of the file at the head.

S1 (should-fix) — the new rule collides with a standing rule of the same file and names no precedence. Build & Test says "a test is deleted only when its PR names a duplicate pinning that assertion at a layer at least as close to the code (ruling record 6120820653)". The new sentence orders "delete it, and any check whose only job is keeping it equal to a registry". The card's draft said "gate or test", and a test that asserts a registry tally is the plainest member of "check"; such a test has no duplicate to name, by construction. A dev who meets one now holds two binding sentences that give opposite orders, and a reviewer can bounce the deletion on 6120820653 or the retention on this rule with equal right. The PR body's "no other gate is licensed for deletion" does not address this. Fix: one clause that makes the precedence explicit at either sentence (for example, that a count-sync test is deleted under this rule without a named duplicate), paid for inside the ruled delta or by deletion.

S2 (should-fix) — the file still breaks its own new ⛔ at this head. Route & surface ownership opens "Five rules." above a list numbered 1 to 5: a count of rules, the first example the new sentence names, that moves when a sixth rule lands and that no reader acts on. Ruling 7233980615 reads "the rule applies to AGENTS.md itself" and takes the deleted bytes off the delta, so this tally is both a self-contradiction on the landing head and about a dozen bytes of raise the text does not need. The PR body's zero-hit grep searched digit forms only and could not see it. Fix: delete it in the same round as S1 and lower the row by what it frees. Seen and not graded, because each is arguable as a count a reader acts on or as frozen: "those eleven names" (required contexts treated as contract), "frozen to the ten" (the `plugin-` prefix), "Two PreToolUse hooks".

N1 (nit) — the rule carries no "(ruling record N)" provenance in the file, where the neighbouring ruled sentences of Build & Test do. The file's header makes the citation the form of a provenance, not a duty on every sentence, and the 7044162186 sentence landed without one. Accepted deviation; the row comment in the ratchet carries the id.

N2 (nit) — the maintainer's option-A choice lives only in the project chat. A transcription onto card #37887 as a ruling record would let the queue guard's reader and any later reviewer read it. A card comment, no head move.

Otherwise the rule holds. It is one sentence pair in the executable form the header asks for, with no incident narrative or tracker number; it sits in the closest existing rule set and is in Contents through that section; it is not restated in `CLAUDE.md`. Its scope is at least the draft's ("docs" is wider than `content/docs`, deliberately or not, and safely). The exception "unless a reader acts on it (a limit, quota, price)" keeps the byte ceilings, the suite-weight ceilings and the shrink-only ratchet baselines out of reach, and "whose only job" keeps every census or ratchet that guards anything else out of the deletion licence. I tried to read it as a licence to delete a ratchet baseline or a census gate and could not without ignoring one of those two qualifiers.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, the code against the contract. The header's ruled-raise sentence, clause by clause: a ruling of record that orders text into the file (7233980615, with the card's 「同意」); its comment id quoted in the PR body (yes); the measured byte delta quoted in the PR body (+274, and it is the true difference of the two blobs); the row moved in the same PR (yes) by at most that delta (exactly 274). The row comment keeps the earlier raise's history and adds this one in the same shape. The code agrees with the contract; a fix for S1 and S2 moves this row again and the delta review reads the new arithmetic.

## Review summary

**Shape and gates.**
- `l1-face --pr 38127`: CLEAN. Check-runs: 26 success, 21 expected skip, 0 failed.
- 2 files, +8/-3. GOVERNED (`AGENTS.md`), so a human merge is required.
- The ratchet row moves 78401 to 78675, which is exactly the blob delta. The raise is cited per letter B of ruling 6184799323, quoting ruling comment 7233980615.

**Why REWORK.** The contract-tier record 7234332732 (tier verified) leaves two graded findings open on this head. The queue guard reads them as OPEN, so this head cannot land. I agree with both.
- **S1 (should-fix):** the new rule orders deleting "any check whose only job is keeping it equal to a registry". Build & Test already says a test is deleted only when its PR names a duplicate that pins the same assertion (ruling record 6120820653), and a count-sync check has no duplicate to name. The new rule needs one clause of precedence that names the exception, so the two rules do not contradict each other.
- **S2 (should-fix):** at this head, `AGENTS.md` still carries a count that its own new rule forbids: "Five rules." above the numbered list in Route and surface ownership. The PR body's zero-hit grep searched digit forms only. Delete it, and lower the ceiling row by the bytes freed.

**Nits, optional.** N1: the rule carries no ruling citation in the file; this is accepted, because the ratchet row carries the id. N2: the maintainer's option-A choice lives only outside GitHub. Transcribing it onto #37887 would make it readable to the guard.

**Next:** fix S1 and S2 on a new head. A delta contract record and a delta L1 follow, and then it goes to seat 1 for the human merge.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `940743583d21e726339da54af696ed4009d35080`
Local-runs: none
Scope: AGENTS.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Delta record on record 7234332732. Read this round: the one commit `940743583d` on `0bfc1c3a30` (its diff against that parent: `AGENTS.md` 13 lines changed, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` one row), the PR body as it stands, PR comment 7234620650, card #37887 comment 7234354812, ruling record 6120820653 in full, the check-runs on this head, and the touched passages of `AGENTS.md` at this head. Comment 7234354812 is the seat's transcription of the maintainer's decision-card choice; I read the transcription on GitHub, and the card in the project's own chat remains cited by the area and not read by me.

### ① Derived judgments

- Ratchet accept-set, `AGENTS.md` row of `CEILINGS`: 78675 → 78712. Right. The blob of `AGENTS.md` is 78401 bytes at merge base `8e3980a92937a4e9c2042409daa9bca6020670c3` and 78712 bytes at this head, so the row equals the file's real size, the total raise is exactly the measured +311 B, and headroom is 0. No other row, pin or line of the script changes.
- Rule accept-set: the rule gains one parenthesis, "(its PR cites this rule, not the duplicate pin a test deletion needs)". Right: it narrows nothing and widens the deletion licence to no check the sentence did not already name; it only says which citation the deleting PR carries.
- Nine count deletions in `AGENTS.md` prose, each a reworded lead-in over an unchanged list. Right, judged one by one in ④. No rule, gate name, command, prohibition or table row is added, removed or moved.
- Public surface: none. Nothing in the delta ships in a package.
- Check-runs on this head: 26 success, 22 skipped, none failed, none pending. These are the gate verdicts; nothing was re-run.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged by the delta: no changeset, `skip-changeset`, nothing published. `Clause-②: no` still matches the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The raise, re-judged at the new size. Covered. Letter B of 6184799323 asks for the ruling comment's id and the measured byte delta in the raising PR's body, and a row moved in the same PR by at most that delta. The body quotes 7233980615 and 7234354812 and +311 B; the row moves 311 in total and its comment names both records. The +37 B of this round is the precedence parenthesis less the counts deleted; the parenthesis is part of the ordered rule holding against the rest of the file, not new content, and the deletions are the ones the ruling asks for. The transcribed choice reads "by the measured delta (about +300 bytes)", which +311 fits.
- The caution recorded under ③ of 7234332732 (the verbatim words alone also fit pay-by-deletion) is now answered on GitHub by 7234354812, whose quoted option text orders both the deletion and the raise. N2 of that record is done by that comment.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): not applicable, no query, id materialisation or join.
- No new dev flag or open question in this round.

### ④ Design judgment

S1 (should-fix): closed

The rule now reads "delete it, and any check whose only job is keeping it equal to a registry (its PR cites this rule, not the duplicate pin a test deletion needs)". That names the precedence at the point of collision: a dev deleting a count-sync test knows which sentence governs and what the PR cites, and a reviewer can no longer bounce it on the Build & Test sentence. The exception is exactly as wide as "whose only job is keeping it equal to a registry"; every other test deletion still needs its named duplicate. Against ruling 6120820653: I read that comment in full and it holds no test-deletion text at all (it rules the lint lane split), so the clause cannot contradict its words. The standing Build & Test sentence that cites it is outside the diff and unchanged; its purpose, that no pinned assertion is lost, is not defeated, because the only assertion given up is the tally the maintainer ordered deleted (7233980615, and the card's "delete the number (and the gate)"). That the standing sentence's citation is not visibly carried by 6120820653 is a pre-existing matter outside this diff, noted and not reviewed.

S2 (should-fix): closed

"Five rules." is gone ("These rules matter more than usual here ..."), and the row came down with it in the net arithmetic. The eight further deletions, each read in place at this head:

- "Three principles the ratchet's invariants encode:" → "Principles ...". A tally of the bullets beneath it; the bullets are unchanged.
- "Two PreToolUse hooks enforce this" → "PreToolUse hooks ...". Both hooks are still named by path in the same sentence, and "both check" still reads true.
- "the third hook" → "another hook". Still named by file and override switch.
- "Two exemptions:" → "Exemptions:". Both exemptions still follow.
- "Three classes of PR never enter this path" → "These classes ...". Classes (a), (b), (c) follow unchanged; the reader acts on the classes, not on their number.
- "Three generators have no gate at all ... reports all three each run" → "Some generators ... reports each of them every run". The generators are still named. "Some" is a shade vaguer than a closed tally about whether the named list is complete; the sentence already defers to the wrapper's own report, so no instruction changes. Observed, not a finding.
- "Three things to get right:" → "Get these right:". The bullets are unchanged.
- "one of fourteen retirement surfaces" → "one of the retirement surfaces". The sentence sends the reader to the `spec-property-retirement` skill and forbids reconstructing the kit, so the skill, not the tally, is what a reader acts on.

Each is a count that ordinary development moves and that no reader acts on; none is a limit, quota, price, threshold or frozen set. The counts the area kept (the eleven required contexts, "ALL FIVE hold", the ten frozen `plugin-` packages, "those four lift", the three-part finding and the three cures, the 3,000 changed-line limit) are conditions or closed definitions a reader does act on, and keeping them is right. No gate pins any deleted phrase, and the check-runs agree.

The new text carries no volatile count of its own: the parenthesis has no number, and the reworded lead-ins replace tallies with none. The row comment's "+311 B" and the two record ids are the measured delta and provenance the ratchet header requires, not a tally that development moves.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` against the header's ruled-raise sentence, clause by clause at this head: ruling of record ordering the text in (7233980615 with the card's 「同意」, and 7234354812); ids quoted in the PR body (yes); measured byte delta quoted (+311, true to the two blobs); row moved in the same PR by at most that delta (exactly 311). The code agrees with the contract.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czzx9dtSEm3jWWL9c3`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- 做什么：开发规范（AGENTS.md）加一条规矩：会随开发变化、又没人据此做事的数字（规则条数、文件数、注册表大小）直接删，不再同步；顺手删掉开发规范自己现有的几处无用计数。这是你在 #37887 说的「没用的统计数字直接删，不同步」。
- 风险：2 个文件 +19/−14，只改开发座位读的规范，不碰产品行为。AGENTS.md 的字节上限按你在决策卡上选的 A 从 78401 上调到 78712（+311 B），正好是这版文件的实际大小。
- 要你做什么：审批人批准即可。契约审核 PASS 7234652832，Head-sha `940743583d21e726339da54af696ed4009d35080`；批准后座位自主落地。
- 不批会怎样：开发座位还会为了让无意义的数字和注册表对齐而反复改文档、误报检查失败。

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, 2 files (+19/−14): `AGENTS.md` (+18/−13) and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (+1/−1, the `AGENTS.md` row of `CEILINGS` only). Body: `Fixes #37887`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `check-governed-merges` reads GOVERNED via `AGENTS.md` ⇒ Tier H.

The contract reviewer accepted the citation in 7234652832.
5. **Out of scope → where it went.** Nothing graded is open: the delta contract record closes S1 and S2 of 7234332732. `Security-touching: no`.
6. **Landing terms.** L1-a ACCEPT (delta) 7234658975 + contract review PASS 7234652832 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, same head) ⇒ ②③ in one `--handoff` stroke. After an authorised APPROVED, seat 1 lands it (maintainer's seat-thread line 2026-11-26T13:33Z 「审批人批准后的 Tier H PR 你可以自主落地」). A head move other than a clean main merge withdraws the hand-off.
